sources.title: Riot: Clarity in League
sources.read: Three goals: convey gameplay, preserve hierarchy, minimise noise
sources.application: Current person/choice/page takes priority over equally weighted panels; motion tied to actual state

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline114: UI context
sources.read: Context must show location/function/expected interaction, player-initiated shifts or notification
sources.application: View, select, confirm and actual travel/seal labelled separately; reading return and anchors retain context

limitations: Specific layout, page/cache/finite navigation choices are project inference; no certification, source-mandated timing, competitor session or whole-art/user acceptance
